optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Mobile Application Engineer, Enterprise Knowledge Base
professionalSummary: Experienced mobile engineer focused on offline sync and search for enterprise knowledge base apps on iOS and Android.
Demonstrated ability to reduce sync failure rates and improve crash-free sessions against published baselines.
Collaborated closely with content teams to coordinate releases and documented responsibilities and limitations.
experienceHighlights: Developed delta‑sync module in Kotlin and Swift, replacing full‑catalogue downloads with change‑set downloads and resumable transfers for intermittent connectivity.
Reduced sync failure rate from 6.8% to 2.1% between March and June releases, measured against the product baseline of 6.8% for Jan‑Feb.
Coordinated release contents for four releases, handling sync and search changes while release manager set dates and scope.
Triaged crash and sync reports from field staff, documenting root causes in the engineering wiki and linking fixes.
Managed offline sync development, quality‑indicator reporting, release coordination and support triage over ~2 years.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Sync‑failure‑rate report exported from the app analytics dashboard (weekly rate, attempts, baseline line, release markers for March and June) and delta‑sync design note, with dashboard export identifiers as verification trail.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample documents the candidate’s development of offline sync and search features, measurable improvement of sync failure rates, coordination with content teams, and triage of crash reports. The evidence does not establish the candidate’s involvement in crash‑free session metrics, production deployment responsibilities, or documentation of known limitations and hand‑over conditions.

role.roleTitle: Mobile Application Engineer, Enterprise Knowledge Base

evidence.text: Developed the delta-sync module for the knowledge base app (Kotlin and Swift), replacing the full-catalogue download with change-set downloads and a resumable transfer when field devices lose connectivity.
evidence.notes: Directly describes offline sync development on iOS and Android.

evidence.text: Responsibilities included offline sync development, quality‑indicator reporting, release coordination and support triage for the knowledge base app over about two years.

Reduced the sync failure rate from 6.8 percent to 2.1 percent of sync attempts between the March and June releases, measured by the app analytics dashboard against the product's published baseline of 6.8 percent for the January to February period.
Coordinated release contents with the content team for four releases; my part covered the sync and search changes, while the release manager decided the release date and scope.
evidence.notes: Indicates coordination but not full responsibility boundaries.
